title: Shrike EngineConfig
description: The normalized, camelCase configuration passed from the TypeScript host to the Rust engine, plus host-side check and pull-request options. A minimal empty object is valid and produces the documented defaults. Unknown keys are rejected with a helpful error.

ignore.description: Glob set skipped during inventory. Default: [".next/**", "node_modules/**", "dist/**", "build/**", "coverage/**", ".shrike/**"].

tsconfig.description: tsconfig used for paths and baseUrl resolution. Default: "tsconfig.json".

cacheDir.description: Content-addressed cache directory, safe to delete. Default: ".shrike/cache".

workspaces.description: Workspace globs for monorepo boundaries. Default: [] (detected from package.json workspaces or pnpm-workspace.yaml).

entryPolicy.description: Entry seeding policy. production excludes test and Storybook entries; local includes tests; ci matches production. Default: "production".

includeTests.description: Include test entries when entryPolicy is local. Default: true.

includeStories.description: Include Storybook story entries. Default: false.

publicApi.description: Public API markers. Defaults: packageExports true, declarationFiles true, indexSurface true.

generated.description: Generated-file policy. Defaults: exclude true with the documented patterns.

batchPolicy.description: Blast-radius cap. Defaults: maxSymbols 50, maxFiles 10, maxLiveGraphPercent 5, allowOversized false.

checks.description: Project checks in execution order. Default: [] (detect from package.json scripts).

pr.description: Pull-request options. Defaults: draft true, labels ["shrike","cleanup"], branchPrefix "shrike/cleanup", commentReceipt true, base "main".

verification.description: Verifier options. Defaults: mode worktree, allowDirty false, tier standard, baselinePath ".shrike/baseline.json".

build.description: Optional Next.js build-graph evidence. Defaults: evidence false, snapshot ".next/analyze.jsonl", requireEvidence false.

receipts.description: Receipt output. Defaults: dir ".shrike/receipts", write true.

output.description: CLI output. Defaults: format text, color true.

resolver.description: Resolver extensions, conditions, and aliases. Defaults: standard TypeScript extensions and import/require/types/default conditions.

maxWorkers.description: Maximum parse workers; 0 means auto. Default: 0.

packageExports.description: Treat package.json exports/main/module/types surfaces as public. Default: true.

declarationFiles.description: Treat declaration files as public. Default: true.

indexSurface.description: Treat a library index.ts public surface as public. Default: true.

exclude.description: Exclude generated files from deletion candidates while still parsing them for edges. Default: true.

maxLiveGraphPercent.description: Maximum percent of the live graph a batch may remove. Default: 5.

allowOversized.description: Allow an oversized SCC with an explicit, recorded override. Default: false.

name.description: Stable check name, for example typecheck.

command.description: Exact shell command. The verifier never guesses from a script name when this is supplied.

required.description: A required check blocks a verified outcome. Default: true.

reruns.description: Rerun count for flaky classification. Default: 0 (1 for tests is recommended).

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the worktree. Default: ".".

draft.description: Open the cleanup PR as a draft. Default: true.

labels.description: Labels applied to the PR. Default: ["shrike","cleanup"].

commentReceipt.description: Post the receipt as a PR comment. Default: true.

base.description: Base branch for the PR. Default: "main".

mode.description: Apply mode. worktree is the CI default; in-place requires a clean tree. Default: "worktree".

allowDirty.description: Allow in-place verification on a dirty tree. Default: false.

evidence.description: Consume next analyze export evidence. Default: false.

snapshot.description: Path to the JSONL build export. Default: ".next/analyze.jsonl".

requireEvidence.description: Fail closed with exit 4 when evidence is absent, stale, malformed, or unsupported. Default: false.

nextVersion.description: Optional pinned Next.js version. Detected from package.json when omitted.

write.description: Write receipts for every batch, including rejected ones. Default: true.

color.description: Use ANSI color in terminal output. Default: true.

aliases.description: Explicit alias map, for example {"@/": "src/"}. Default: {}.

conditions.description: Package exports conditions in order. Default: ["import","require","types","default"].
